subject: Foresight pilot success metrics & ops plan
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Bennett <sarah@foresight.ai>, Tom Alvarez <tom@foresight.ai>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Foresight pilot success metrics & ops plan

Hi Sarah / Tom —

Great conversation earlier today. Per our call, I captured a focused playbook for the pilot so we have a tight acceptance path and clear owners. Please find the two quick asks below: confirm the evaluation window and flag any constraints on test traffic (rate limits, PII filters, or geo restrictions).

Quick summary (attached: pilot_success_template.xlsx):
- Goal: Validate model quality and unit economics for FORESIGHT.ai search-summarization flow.
- Window: 6 weeks of active evaluation (configurable based on infra readiness).
- Success focus: latency, throughput, cost/token, and quality relative to your labeled set.

I attached a lightweight template with the KPI table — if you can populate the sample queries and the labeled quality set by EOD Wednesday we can lock week 1 test harness.

Next steps from Redwood (owners in parens):
- Deliver pilot runbook and sandbox endpoint (Michael) — planned by Wed EOD.
- Eng readiness sync for KV cache and batching config (Olga) — 30-min call Thurs.
- SRE acceptance criteria for scale tests (Ben) — will provide stress script and thresholds.

Attachments: pilot_success_template.xlsx (Excel; KPI table + sample queries)

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Michael Grant
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
michael@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: Sarah Bennett <sarah@foresight.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom@foresight.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 18:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Foresight pilot success metrics & ops plan

Thanks Michael — solid recap. A couple quick clarifications from our side before we populate the template: 

1) Traffic profile: we can generate up to ~1,200 requests/min during the test spike window, but steady-state is closer to 300–400 reqs/min. Can Redwood SRE handle 1,200 spike sim?
2) Latency expectations: our bar for production UX is p95 < 250ms. If Redwood proposes p95 < 200ms in the plan that would be ideal; just want to make sure we align on what’s realistic for the earliest weeks.
3) Cost/token: we need a ballpark for unit cost that maps to our pricing model so we can run cost sensitivity internally. Can you share a sample cost estimate for the trial config?

We’ll aim to fill the sample queries + labeled quality set by Wed 11/18 EOD.

— Sarah
Head of Product | Foresight.ai
sarah@foresight.ai

From: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Bennett <sarah@foresight.ai>, Tom Alvarez <tom@foresight.ai>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Foresight pilot success metrics & ops plan

Thanks Sarah — glad that timeline works. Below is a concrete, short acceptance matrix and the ops runway we propose. If that looks good I’ll lock the kickoff calendar invite and drop the runbook (attached PDF) into the shared Drive.

Proposed acceptance criteria (high level):
- Latency (perf): p95 <= 200ms over a 24h rolling window during steady-state (300–400 reqs/min). P95 can rise to 350ms during controlled spike tests up to 1,200 reqs/min. (Owner: Olga)
- Throughput (scale): sustained 400 reqs/min for a minimum 48h soak; spike test to 1,200 reqs/min for 30 minutes with <1% error rate. (Owner: Ben)
- Cost efficiency: target gross cost <= $0.0025 per token for the trial configuration (includes batching + KV caching). We will provide a detailed cost breakdown by token type after we finalize model variant. (Owner: Michael)
- Quality (functional): benchmark pass-rate >= 92% on your labeled sample set (evaluated blind by your team); additional quality regression threshold: delta <= 3% vs baseline. (Owner: Monica)

Operational timeline (6-week runway):
- Week 0 (pre-kickoff): Foresight provides labeled sample set + sample queries (Sarah) — due 2026-11-18 EOD
- Week 1: Redwood delivers sandbox endpoint, runbook, and baseline performance profile (Michael / Olga)
- Week 2: Functional quality tests with labeled set; tune prompt/model variant (Michael / Monica)
- Week 3–4: Soak test at steady-state; iterate on batching/cache config (Olga / Ben)
- Week 5: Spike tests & cost extrapolation; produce final metrics report (Ben / Michael)
- Week 6: Evaluation readout and decision (all stakeholders)

Key deliverables and owners (single line):
- Pilot runbook + sandbox endpoint — Michael Grant (Redwood)
- Performance tuning & kernel selection recommendations — Olga Petrov (Redwood)
